description: The Poldertoren stands in the open square of De Deel, an octagonal brown-brick tower with an open lantern and a low tent roof. The sky is fully overcast, about 14.0°C, with wind near 2.9 km/h and no rain. Square lamps light the paving. The renovation that reopened the tower in April 2026 left the exterior clear, so no scaffold is shown.
